definitions: 孤独的；独自的；单独存在的（alone, single）

examples.text: At the very edge of this kingdom, there lay a small forest. Within it, an ancient solitary tree quietly watched over the inhabitants of the forest.
examples.explanation: 这里的 “solitary tree” 指一棵单独生长、孤零零存在的树；solitary 用来形容某人或某物独自存在、没有同伴。

source.text: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time – Nintendo Direct 6.9.2026
